map.输入正负样本预测得分，估算 ROC 曲线下面积 AUC，评估分类器排序能力，适用: Enter the predicted scores of positive and negative samples to estimate the ROC curve area (AUC) and evaluate the ranking ability of a classifier, which suits model selection, threshold-independent performance comparison and reporting.
map.AUC ≈ 0.5 + 0.5·erf[(μ₊ − μ₋)/√(2(σ₊² +: AUC ≈ 0.5 + 0.5·erf[(μ₊ − μ₋)/√(2(σ₊² + σ₋²))]; the separability d' = (μ₊ − μ₋)/√[(σ₊² + σ₋²)/2]
map.在正负样本得分各自近似正态的假设下，AUC 可由两分布的均值差与方差直接算出，无: Under the assumption that the positive and negative sample scores are each approximately normal, the AUC can be computed directly from the difference in means and the variances of the two distributions without pairwise comparison, which suits a quick estimate when only summary statistics are available. If the real distributions are heavy-tailed or strongly skewed, the approximation drifts from the measured AUC and you should switch to the rank-based method.
map.AUC 为 ROC 曲线下面积，等价于随机正样本得分高于随机负样本的概率。: AUC is the area under the ROC curve, equivalent to the probability that a random positive sample scores higher than a random negative one.
map.AUC=0.5 为随机分类，1 为完美；对类别不平衡与阈值选择不敏感。: AUC = 0.5 is random classification and 1 is perfect; it is insensitive to class imbalance and threshold choice.
map.近似可用梯形法逐点算 ROC 下面积，或 Mann-Whitney 由秩和估算。: An approximation can integrate the area under the ROC point by point with the trapezoid method, or estimate it from the rank sum with the Mann-Whitney test.
map.：某模型 AUC=0.85：随机抽取一正一负样本，正样本得分更高概率 85%。相: A model with AUC=0.85: when a positive and a negative sample are drawn at random, the positive one scores higher with 85% probability. Unlike accuracy, which needs a fixed threshold, AUC gives the overall ranking quality.
map.AUC 高但线上效果差？: High AUC but poor production results?
map.AUC 只反映排序能力，不保证某业务阈值下的准确率/召回；且训练/验证分布若与线: AUC only reflects ranking ability and does not guarantee accuracy or recall at a given business threshold; and if the training or validation distribution drifts from production, a high AUC can still perform poorly in production.
map.样本极不平衡 AUC 还准吗？: Is the AUC still accurate with a very unbalanced sample?
map.AUC 本身对不平衡稳健(基于排序)，但正类极少时估计方差大、且业务更关心正类召: AUC itself is robust to imbalance (it is rank-based), but when positives are very few the estimate has high variance and the business cares more about positive-class recall, so pair it with PR-AUC.
